title: Graph load accepts a gate note whose refs disagree with its gate's evidence reference
outcome: A snapshot history note that carries a gate is accepted only when its refs are exactly what the store would hold for that gate, so a loaded store re-saves the same evidence reference.
acceptance: A gate note saved, loaded and re-saved keeps the same evidence reference, covered by a round-trip test
graph load (and its dry run) refuses as a corrupt file a history note whose gate evidence reference does not match the note's refs as the store writes them, covered by a load-refusal test

completion.summary: Graph load, its dry run and save's own document check now refuse a gate note whose refs are not exactly [] (no evidence reference) or [evidence_ref], in native and carried layers, without normalizing or writing. A loaded store therefore saves the same reference again. Round-trip and refusal tests cover three saves and two loads, plus missing, extra, mismatched and unreferenced refs. The pre-landing audit of copies of all four live stores found zero inconsistent gate refs. Landed as 7244219 with w-c36f7b36bcdf (bundle 7 group B): gate test-313008e9 PASS on freeze 5c6e6d97…, pair clean, independent evaluation passing both criteria, readiness ready on all 4 stores.
